subject.title: test(ui): split the oversized Control UI e2e suites

question: Should this protected, large test-suite refactor land after the final Control UI E2E/lint gates complete and a maintainer accepts the available mock-backed validation for this test-only change?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the PR changes shared E2E lifecycle ownership across a large set of tests rather than a narrowly isolated test file.

options.title: Review and land after final gates
options.body: Confirm the exact-head UI E2E results and merge refresh, then accept the focused suite layout and shared lifecycle extraction.

options.title: Request an additional real harness transcript
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript from a local Control UI E2E run if maintainers require non-CI evidence beyond the reported mocked suite results.

recommendation.title: Review and land after final gates
recommendation.body: Confirm the exact-head UI E2E results and merge refresh, then accept the focused suite layout and shared lifecycle extraction.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed Control UI work connects this contributor to the affected E2E support and new-session test surfaces.
